dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Patriots (5-5) Week 12 Briefing: Injury Updates Ahead of Chargers
bullets: Injury & Practice Status: Entering Week 12 preparation, head coach Mike Vrabel and the medical staff evaluate QB Drake Maye (lower leg), WR A.J. Brown (hamstring), QB Tommy DeVito (lower leg), and OL Walter Rouse (concussion) ahead of Wednesday's initial participation report [Nick Goss](https://www.nbcsportsboston.com/nfl/new-england-patriots/drake-maye-injury-patriots-lions-surgery-return/815003/) [Evan Lazar](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4047646/aj-brown#:~:text=Brown%20%28hamstring%29%20didn't%20take%20part%20in%20practice). G Alijah Vera-Tucker (hamstring) and WR Romeo Doubs (shoulder) continue ramping inside active 21-day Injured Reserve practice windows toward potential 53-man roster activation [Bernd Buchmasser](https://www.patspulpit.com/new-england-patriots-news/145218/romeo-doubs-return-patriots-practice-chargers-injured-reserve).

Week 12 Chargers Outlook: Mike Vrabel and DC Zak Kuhr open installation for the Los Angeles Chargers (1-9, LAC -1.5, HC Jim Harbaugh, OC Mike McDaniel & DC Chris O'Leary (Road Test)) as New England prepares for a pivotal AFC matchup [Marima](https://www.patspulpit.com/new-england-patriots-news/145136/patriots-news-pats-need-defense-in-top-form-to-tackle-chargers) [patriots.com Official](https://www.patriots.com/news/patriots-gameplan-how-will-the-offense-adjust-for-qb-tommy-devito-in-sunday-s-week-12-matchup-vs-the-chargers).

AFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 5-5 (2nd in AFC East • #8 Seed in AFC), New England carries a 40% postseason projection, 1.1% AFC East division title mark, and 0.1% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [Bernd Buchmasser](https://www.patspulpit.com/new-england-patriots-nfl-playoffs/145149/afc-playoffs-steelers-benche-starting-qb-aaron-rodgers).

Around the Beat: Anything remains possible for Patriots in final seven games [Michael Hurley](https://www.nbcsportsboston.com/nfl/new-england-patriots/anything-remains-possible-final-seven-games/814882/).
